description: A mitten in Oslo stitch, its notation typed in lower case (uo/uoo f1), with a recipe in working order: a foundation chain of 36 joined into a ring, 12 cuff rounds, a thumb opening that skips 6 loops and works 6 stitches across, 20 rounds for the hand, a tip decreased by 10 stitches in each of 4 rounds, a finish, then a free-text care step outside the part. The strict reading accepts the notation and reports each lower-case run (uo, uoo, f) as a formatting note, so the stitch itself is checked and is clean. The recipe counts 36 stitches to the tip, where 4 rounds of 10 decreases would remove 40: an error; the thumb opening is never worked or closed: a warning; the care step is free text Ply does not read: not checked. Readiness: the decrease blocks, the opening warns, the free text is listed as not checked, the formatting notes are information.

items.message: Removes 40 stitches (10 in each of 4 rounds), but the round has only 36
This opening is never worked or closed: add a pick-up that starts from it, or a join that closes it
Ply did not check this step: it is free text, which Ply does not read, and it is printed as written.
